title: Enabling Agents to Communicate Entirely in Latent Space
authors: Zhuoyun Du; Runze Wang; Huiyu Bai; Zouying Cao; Xiaoyong Zhu; Yu Cheng; Bo Zheng; Wei Chen; Haochao Ying
venue_full: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
affiliations: Zhejiang University, Alibaba, Zhejiang Key Laboratory of Medical Imaging Artificial Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
research_focus: Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Natural-language multi-agent systems compress rich high-dimensional internal states into sequential discrete tokens, discarding alternative reasoning paths and adding redundant decode-re-encode latency. Prior hidden-state communication remains tied to language trajectories or requires ad hoc layer selection.
problem_statement.zh: 以 natural language 運作的多 agent 系統，會將豐富的高維內部 state 壓縮為循序離散 token，因而捨棄替代推理路徑，並增加冗餘的 decode-re-encode latency。既有 hidden-state 通訊仍依附於 language trajectory，或需要臨時性的 layer 選擇。

key_innovation.en: Interlat directly transmits temporally aligned last-layer hidden-state sequences from a reasoning sender to an actor, where a trainable self-attention/projector communication adapter and <bop>/<eop> delimiters enable interpretation; a token-to-latent curriculum with separation and plan-alignment objectives forces use of task-relevant latent content. A separate latent-reasoning model autoregressively generates fixed-length compressed messages under task, uncertainty-weighted agreement, and geometry-alignment losses.
key_innovation.zh: Interlat 將 reasoning sender 在時間上對齊的 last-layer hidden-state sequence 直接傳至 actor，並以可訓練的 self-attention/projector communication adapter 與 <bop>/<eop> delimiter 支援解析；token-to-latent curriculum 搭配 separation 與 plan-alignment objective，促使 actor 使用與 task 相關的 latent content。另一個 latent-reasoning model 則在 task、uncertainty-weighted agreement 與 geometry-alignment loss 約束下，auto-regressively 生成固定長度的 compressed message。

key_improvements.en: On unseen ALFWorld tasks with Qwen2.5-0.5B, Interlat reaches 57.46% success versus 47.26% for Text and 44.03% for No-Comm. In a separate Qwen2.5-7B compression study, training-free truncation to eight latent steps reduces message-generation latency from 9.19s to 0.39s (nearly 24×) while maintaining competitive performance.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Qwen2.5-0.5B 的 unseen ALFWorld task 上，Interlat 的 success rate 為 57.46%，高於 Text 的 47.26% 與 No-Comm 的 44.03%。在另一項 Qwen2.5-7B compression 實驗中，training-free truncation 至八個 latent step，可在維持具競爭力表現的同時，將 message-generation latency 由 9.19s 降至 0.39s（接近 24× 加速）。

reuse_metric.en: Trained compression reduces each latent message to eight steps, about 1.8% of the full sequence, while retaining 66.43%/60.45% seen/unseen ALFWorld success versus 70.48%/65.42% with full-length latent communication.
reuse_metric.zh: 經訓練的 compression 將每則 latent message 縮減至八個 step，約為完整 sequence 的 1.8%；其 ALFWorld seen/unseen success rate 為 66.43%/60.45%，而完整 latent communication 則為 70.48%/65.42%。
